qualityReview.identity: Preserves S-curved amphibian body, blackglass scales, pale violet underside, broad torn violet veils, short webbed limbs, jade eyes and toxic fangs.
qualityReview.scene: Wet mangrove root supports the coiled animal; foreground leaves and water, root middle ground, distant trunks and moonlit channel give clear depth and coherent reflections.
qualityReview.composition: Head and dorsal veil upper half, sinuous tail leads through lower half, bright fangs and violet veil separate clearly from blue environment.
qualityReview.constraints: Opaque illustration; no text, frame, UI, logo or watermark seen.
caveats: One rear limb is occluded by the coil; three limbs are visible and species silhouette is retained.
